# Guillaume Coqueret

::: role
Professor of Finance, emlyon business school
:::

I am a professor of finance at [emlyon business school](https://www.em-lyon.com/en/) and an affiliated professor at the [ENS de Lyon](https://www.ens-lyon.fr/en/), within the [CERGIC](https://www.cergic-lyon.fr/).

My research interests include supervised learning for financial economics, sustainable equity investing and, more generally, the impact of AI on organizations.
